jobs.title: Full-Time LSAT Tutor
jobs.description: About Inspira Education Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities. As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide. As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub). The Role We are looking for an experienced full-time LSAT Tutor to provide one-on-one LSAT preparation to students. You will teach all sections of the LSAT, develop individualized study plans, and track student progress throughout their preparation. This is a full-time, remote role that can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. The 40-hour workweek includes 5–10 hours of preparation time, with tutoring scheduled around student availability, including weekday afternoons, evenings, and weekends. Responsibilities Tutor students one-on-one across all sections of the LSAT Develop and adapt LSAT study plans based on each student's needs and performance Track and analyze student progress Create and maintain project trackers to monitor LSAT preparation progress Keep students' families up to date on academic progress and milestones Participate in additional opportunities as they arise, such as leading webinars or training other tutors Qualifications Bachelor's degree or higher Previously taken the Law School Admission Test (LSAT); official score report required LSAT score in the 99th percentile 2+ years of LSAT tutoring or LSAT test-pre

jobs.description: Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients. About the Role: We’re looking for a highly consultative Dental Field Trainer in Germany to lead impactful, in-person training that accelerates early clinical success with Dandy’s digital dentistry solutions. This role is field-based, with up to 80% travel , and is focused on helping dental practices adopt intraoral scanning and digital workflows with confidence. You’ll serve as a trusted clinical advisor to dentists, practice managers, and operational leaders—helping teams adopt new technology, digital workflows, improve clinical performance, and accelerate early success. This role combines clinical training expertise with operational execution and post-training insight to deliver measurable value at the intersection of training, technology, and practice growth. Success in this role comes from your ability to earn clinical trust and turn that trust into action — helping practices move from curiosity to confidence. Coach teams based on live observation, reinforcing best practices and adapting in real time to meet the practice’s goals and maturity level. jobs.title: Math Teacher Eye Level PIK 2
jobs.description: Requirements : Minimum D3/S1, preferably in Mathematics, Mathematics Education, English Education, English Literature, or related fields. Experienced in teaching Primary and Secondary students, preferably in an international school or international curriculum environment. Able to explain mathematical concepts clearly, patiently, and systematically. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Teaching or tutoring experience is a plus. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Patient, disciplined, honest, responsible, committed, creative, and proactive. Tech-savvy and able to adapt to a structured learning environment. Willing to introduce and promote the Eye Level learning program to students and parents. Willing to undergo Eye Level training and follow the Eye Level teaching methodology. Well-groomed and professional in appearance. Willing to work onsite. General Responsibilities : Teach Mathematics to children aged 4-15 years old according to the Eye Level curriculum and teaching methodology. Provide academic coaching in a small-group learning environment based on each student's individual progress. Explain mathematical concepts clearly and guide students to develop independent learning skills. Motivate and encourage students throughout their learning process. Monitor, grade, and maintain students' academic progress and learning reports. Communicate effectively and professionally with students, parents, and Center staff. Introduce and explain the Eye Level program to prospective students and parents when needed. Perform administrative and operational activities related to teaching when required. Identify and report students' learning difficulties or other concerns to the Center Director. Participate actively in Eye Level training and other center activities.
